title: The Judge Is the Benchmark: reproduction kit (paper source, prompts, verdicts, scripts)
description: Public reproduction kit for the paper "The Judge Is the Benchmark: The Same Answers Score 91% or 35%, Depending on the Grading Prompt". Contains the LaTeX source, the two grading prompts and the ported LongMemEval rubric, Mem0's published LoCoMo answers (Apache-2.0), committed per-answer judge verdicts, the judge-free recall and judge-error recomputes, and the one-command paid re-judge of the control slice. Every load-bearing number in the paper traces to a file in this archive.

creators.name: Ustyuzhanin, Andrey
